propositions: code_health metric is currently Python-only and language-coupled, requiring polyglot analyzer stack for portability to non-Python projects
existing metrics fabricate zeros or leak exceptions when scanning hardcoded paths on unsupported language projects instead of reporting honest Unavailable status
analyzer interface must be pluggable behind optional [metrics] extra so rebar core gains zero hard dependencies on scc/lizard/jscpd
per-project config must replace hardcoded scan paths and thresholds with configurable language/tool selection and policy
missing or unconfigured analyzer for a project language must emit genuine Unavailable with clear reason, never fabricate data or expose raw exceptions
module-size CAP policy must be decoupled from hardcoded rebar governance artifacts and re-expressed as optional policy layer over generic LOC signal
